newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Costello declines rate comment.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Costello declines rate comment.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello on Tuesday declined to comment on the Reserve Bank's February Bulletin, in which the bank said current monetary policy was appropriate for the time being.

Asked by a reporter whether the bank had been premature in "ruling out" a monetary easing, Costello said the bank had not said that. "I don't think the bank said that. I think what the bank said, as I recall, in its quarterly Bulletin, was that monetary policy was appropriate," he said.
"Now you can read whatever you want into that," he said.
The Reserve Bank eased monetary policy three times between July and December, progressively lowering its target for overnight cash rates to 6.0 percent from 7.5 percent.
